ValidationRule.description: uAssist Status cannot be changed if 'Send to Webapp' is checked b/c of a previous change. Prevents anyone team from working too quickly for Boomi to pick up changes.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(uAssist_Status__c), Send_to_WebApp__c, NOT( OR( $Profile.Name = "System Administrator", $Profile.Name = "ULab SysAdmin", $Profile.Name = "Test System Admin" ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please wait for earlier changes to be pushed to our other systems before changing the uAssist Status.
